brief: A paper lantern in a small mountain shrine.
baseline: Distance-march a rounded lantern, rails and plinth as a compound kind.
improve: Replace the compound march with analytic visibility and a vis-buffer schedule. Bind World visibility rays in shade_tiles and compare hardware traversal where reported.
measure: Compare march versus visibility pass p95, shadow parity and lantern silhouette at identical framing.

baseline: Shade the assembled clay silhouette and painted hairline with one stock PBR lighting pass.
improve: Fork the schedule for ink contours from visibility depth and normals, then composite a screen-space outline.
measure: Check silhouette continuity and crack legibility at two resolutions. Report outline cost separately.

brief: A striped lighthouse under a layered sunset.
baseline: Evaluate a procedural atmosphere at every background pixel on every frame.
improve: Cache the atmosphere in a sky cubemap, dirty it on sky or sun changes, and use a separate lighting pass for the lighthouse.
measure: Compare steady and invalidated frame p95, sky gradient and horizon seams.

brief: Copper, canvas and jade market stalls.
baseline: Repeat the stall geometry across three kinds whose only differences are material fields.
improve: Use one drawable kind and a packed MaterialTable indexed by row. Scale variety at fixed population.
measure: Compare pipeline count, material parity and p95 at 3 and 30 variants. Test the zero added-pass target.

brief: A glass jellyfish pulsing above a dark seabed.
baseline: Use opaque glossy glass cues and painted base illumination under a pulsing bell.
improve: Add a thickness-aware water and caustic pass or fork the spectral integrator to transport refracted light onto the ground.
measure: Track caustic displacement through one pulse and measure p95 with the same camera and pulse phase.

brief: A clockwork beetle crossing wet paving.
baseline: Swing rigid leg capsules together as the chassis slides forward.
improve: Predict stance anchors with capture_point_ff, solve knee positions with solve_2bone_ik and add a planted-foot check in World space.
measure: Measure planted drift in mm across a stride, at 30, 60 and 120 Hz.

brief: A stone golem rises out of a crouch.
baseline: Translate all upper-body parts with the same scripted rise. The feet remain fixed.
improve: Drive a joint chain with spring_chain_step and time the rise with anticipation_overshoot. Shape impact with squash_stretch.
measure: Measure delay between hip and fist peaks, first overshoot, settle time and stationary foot drift.

brief: A neutral heron waiting in a marsh.
baseline: Solve an S-shaped neck from a fixed head goal and leave the body frozen.
improve: Blend mood_timid, mood_alert and mood_proud. Feed the same mood through neck goal, balance and gaze laws.
measure: Record head height, gaze settling and leg anchor drift through both transitions.

brief: A segmented sea serpent lifting a crest.
baseline: Give each segment a local bob with no shared spine constraints.
improve: Run a travelling-wave solver law with arc-length spacing and spring-driven crest follow-through.
measure: Measure adjacent separation and phase delay at two swimming speeds.

brief: A blue splash throwing sand beads from a tidepool.
baseline: Draw separate scripted ballistic beads. There is no particle-to-grid momentum exchange.
improve: Add an MPM P2G kernel with allow(atomics, workgroup) and compare NonDet floating accumulation to deterministic fixed-point accumulation.
measure: Compare momentum error, rerun repeatability and p95 as the particle count grows.

brief: Stepping stones across a blackwater pond.
baseline: Shade one looping centered ripple over a flat pool. Stone rows never inject energy.
improve: Advance a wave field in a custom GPU pass, splat stone contacts, and couple the result into World surface normals.
measure: Compare wave travel speed from an off-axis impact, shoreline reflections and wave-pass p95.

brief: A prism beneath a green and violet aurora.
baseline: Paint dispersion stripes on a solid prism and stretch a thin emissive ribbon behind it.
improve: Author a raw WGSL pass with explicit bindings for spectral separation and composite the result before display.
measure: Verify bindings in the lowered plan. Measure separation in pixels and pass p95 at two resolutions.
